hypothesis: A zero-gated hybrid that retains downstream nonlinear capacity and adds bounded causal raw-input access beats both the exact-size downstream-only control and the immutable no-intervention baseline.

evidence_basis.interpretation: Raw input carried limited target-0/2 signal, but replacing the full downstream adapter damaged target-3/4 performance. The next candidate preserves both paths.

candidate.name: hybrid_downstream101_compact_input269x80_gru31

action_input_alphabet.rule: Static action-contract alphabet containing every ID present in actual action-training inputs plus the token-zero causal anchor; fail closed on any unmapped action input.

candidate.initial_logits_requirement: bit-identical to downstream-only control within the same runtime

mandatory_preflight.actual_training_row_coverage: Every compact embedding row must occur in the real action-training inputs, including row zero through the causal anchor.
mandatory_preflight.effective_dof: After a deterministic two-step witness on actual training rows, every one of 140820 selected scalars in both arms must be gradient-reachable; final changed-scalar count must also be 140820 in every trained arm.
mandatory_preflight.causality: Changing a future input token cannot alter earlier sidecar outputs.
mandatory_preflight.initialization: Candidate and control action logits must be bit-identical for all preregistered initial probes within the execution runtime.
mandatory_preflight.frozen_state: All non-selected tensors, including e, g, count_head, and unused modules, remain byte-identical.
mandatory_preflight.breaker: Independent mutation suite and LAUNCH_GATE_PASS required before upload.

storage_contract.training_scratch_measurement: Measure the exact existing filesystem that will contain live models and checkpoints; never Path.anchor or a different mount.
storage_contract.durable_output: Separately preflight bounded durable-copy capacity, hash-copy each checkpoint/result from scratch, and prove hash-gated restore before launch.
storage_contract.prohibition: Do not lower or reinterpret the 25 GiB training gate.

decision_gate.variance: positive mean delta greater than two pooled standard deviations for both metrics against both controls
decision_gate.finite_evaluation: Bonferroni family alpha 0.05 across paired exact accuracy and seed-target-stratified paired bootstrap macro-F1 against both controls
decision_gate.retention: exact parent counting score and frozen/non-selected tensor hashes
decision_gate.promotion: Only after every gate passes and independent replay agrees
